svg.title: Red-Orange Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive hand-authored study after visual inspection of the1996 Guggenheim retrospective plate. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid palette. Texture, mounting shadows and perspective omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=212; catalogue 79; visually inspected2026-10-27. Interpretive study, not facsimile.
